verificationMethod: SHA-256 of each downloaded asset must equal the digest published for the official v2.7.3 release; tools/fetch-impactor.ps1 and the launcher refuse any other file.

bundledBy: launcher/windows/tools/fetch-impactor.ps1 (Windows) / fetch-impactor.sh (WSL/dev) into ThirdParty/Impactor; the launcher verifies SHA-256 before every use and never rebuilds, patches or re-signs these files.
